title: Telco brings single AI model workspace for subscribers
summary: Most people who want to try AI tools in the Philippines run into the same problem: there are several of them, each with its own subscription, and most are priced in dollars. Local telco player Smart…

blocks.text: Most people who want to try AI tools in the Philippines run into the same problem: there are several of them, each with its own subscription, and most are priced in dollars. Local telco player Smart Communications is trying to address that with AI.Smart, a browser-based workspace that puts several models behind one login and bills in pesos.

The service, built with Avtica, gives Smart and TNT subscribers access to AWS Nova, ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini, and Thinking Machines. Users don’t pick a model themselves. The platform chooses one based on the prompt, whether the task is writing, generating images, building documents and presentations, or analyzing data. It handles English, Filipino, and Taglish.

Smart says files uploaded to a user’s workspace stay private to that workspace and aren’t used to train AI models. The company also says subscriber data isn’t retained, is encrypted, and is handled in line with the Data Privacy Act.

“AI should be for everyone, not just for those who can afford premium AI services,” said Lloyd R. Manaloto, First Vice President and OIC for Smart. He described the platform as a way for more Filipinos to learn, create, and work with AI.

Access runs on credit packs. The entry option is P49 for seven days. A P499 plan lasts 30 days and lets up to 10 users share one pool of credits, which Smart pitches at small businesses and teams. Credits can be paid for with prepaid load, postpaid billing, credit or debit cards, and select e-wallets.
Signing up takes a mobile number and an SMS verification. As a launch promo, new sign-ups can get free access for seven days.
